provenance: PROVISIONAL Factory-side fixture. Issue #12 (LAB) owns candidate generation; when it publishes a family at .artifacts/lab/candidates.json, validate.py prefers it and this file stops being used. These candidates exist so the check set can be exercised and so Lab has a concrete input contract to write to. The verdicts are NOT authored here -- every pass and fail below is computed by tools/factory/checks.py from measured geometry, and the two rejections were found by scanning the assembly, not designed to fail.
goal: Stiffen the S500 centre plate without disturbing any purchased interface.

candidates.label: Baseline S500-C1 as released
candidates.rationale: The unmodified assembly. It must pass the same check set as every candidate; a check set the baseline cannot survive is measuring the fixture, not the design.

candidates.label: Bottom plate +1.0 mm, fasteners lengthened only where they clamp it
candidates.rationale: Stiffen the centre plate and carry the extra 1 mm of grip into the twenty fastener occurrences that actually pass through it, leaving the rest of the fleet alone.

candidates.label: Bottom plate +2.0 mm, same scoped fastener substitution
candidates.rationale: A stiffer variant of cand-a. The same fastener step covers the larger grip growth exactly, so the joint keeps its current engagement.

candidates.label: Bottom plate +2.0 mm, fastener schedule untouched
candidates.rationale: The cheapest version of the same idea: change one plate and leave the hardware alone, on the assumption that 2 mm is small enough not to matter.

candidates.label: Standardise every M2.5 cap screw at 8 mm
candidates.rationale: Cut the fastener schedule down: run one M2.5x8 everywhere instead of mixing lengths, gaining engagement and removing a part number from the kit. Applied at the definition, so it reaches all 28 occurrences.

candidates.label: Thicken the carbon arm tube wall by 1.0 mm
candidates.rationale: Stiffen the arms at the source rather than the centre plate, on the theory that arm deflection dominates.
